cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(signalmint_runtime C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# model_data.h is generated by `python scripts/export_c.py` before building.
add_executable(sm_infer sm_infer.c signalmint_rt.c)
target_include_directories(sm_infer PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

if (MSVC)
    target_compile_options(sm_infer PRIVATE /W3 /O2)
else()
    target_compile_options(sm_infer PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
endif()
